question: What powers of removing aging signs and seeing from very far are attained?
premises: Wrinkles and grey hair are destroyed.
Seeing from very far is also attained.
These are presented as parallel results.
inference: The practitioner gains the destruction of wrinkles and grey hair and the power to see from very far.
plain_english: One gains the destruction of wrinkles and grey hair, and likewise the power to see from very far away.
